blocks.text: Interior design pricing — DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava

parts.html: We create contemporary, thoughtfully designed interiors with a focus on aesthetics, functionality, and quality of execution. Choose the package that fits your property, your goals, and the level of support you need.

blocks.text: The “Express” interior design package — €20/m² Completion time — from 14 days after the layout is approved

parts.html: A fast, practical solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that are already ready for finishing and do not require an extended set of technical documentation.
The package includes a measured floor plan of the space, a functional furniture layout plan, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of each main room, with one full round of revisions.
You see the future interior in advance and can evaluate the layout and how materials, furniture, lighting, and colors work together before finishing work even begins.
The “Express” package is a good fit for those who want to quickly receive a professional interior concept and a clear visual basis for carrying the project forward.
Price: €20/m²
Minimum package price: €1,500
The “Furniture” interior design package — €35–45/m²

An ideal solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that are ready to be furnished. The package includes a measured floor plan, a furniture layout plan, photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with one full round of revisions, and a complete set of furniture drawings for manufacturing custom furniture.
You receive a finished interior concept and a technical brief for manufacturing custom kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, built-in storage systems, and other cabinet furniture.
Price: €35–45/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000
Furniture manufacturing, delivery, and installation based on the completed design are also available.

items.text: Project example: Metropolis residential complex, Bratislava, 75 m²
Project example: Eurovea City residential complex, Bratislava, 56 m²

parts.html: The optimal solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that need a complete interior design project with visualizations and a set of technical documentation for the renovation.

The package includes a measured floor plan, a furniture layout plan, demolition and construction plans, layouts for plumbing fixtures, underfloor heating, power outlets, switches, electrical connection points, lighting, and ceilings, as well as flooring plans, wall elevations for the bathrooms and kitchen, and finishing material specifications and schedules.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for each room, with one full round of revisions.
You receive a finished interior concept and a set of technical drawings the construction crew needs to implement the design accurately.
Price: €35–45/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000
Design supervision, a detailed renovation cost estimate, furnishing and procurement, custom furniture manufacturing, and turnkey renovation are available as add-ons.

items.text: View an example of a project with technical documentation

parts.html: An extended solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that call for the most detailed interior development and professional support in preparing for renovation.

The package includes the full basic set of technical drawings, wall elevations for all rooms, detail drawings and sections, specifications and quantity calculations for the main materials, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with up to two full rounds of revisions.
It also includes two material-selection trips with the designer, which helps bring the approved interior concept to life more precisely.
You receive a thoroughly detailed interior design project with extended technical documentation, needed to implement the interior accurately and to control the renovation work more effectively.
Price: €50/m²
Minimum package price: €2,500
Our most comprehensive package, for those who want a thoroughly detailed interior and full project support during implementation.
The package includes all “Premium” services, plus 2 months of design supervision, furniture drawings, complete finishing material specifications, and schedules for all interior items.
You receive not only an interior design project but also an extended set of documentation and the designer’s support, everything needed to implement the approved concept as precisely as possible.
Price: €70/m²
Minimum package price: €3,500
